pages.title: Small Settlement
pages.text: Small Illager settlements generate in plains, savannas, snowy plains, and taigas. They are the most common settlement type.

pages.title: Occupants
pages.text: Small settlements mainly contain common units such as Pillagers, Vindicators, Grumblagers, and compatible common Illagers from installed mods.$(br2)Allied players can use these camps to find possible recruits outside raids.
